what: CRITICAL (code audit CA-A01-001, MEASURED 2026-09-27T13:02Z): ib_paper has a resting IB OCA group 'oca-protect-t5836' -- SELL STP 15 MESZ6 @7602.5 (order 906) + SELL LMT 15 @8390.5 (order 907), status PreSubmitted, GTC -- while the venue holds NO MES position (/api/diag/exchange_positions: ib_paper = MHG short 22, MGC long 90 only). Its owner, trade 5836 (mes_trend_long_1d, adopted orphan, long 15), was closed 2026-09-19T01:44:44Z by _watchdog_stuck_strategies ('position flat at exchange ... finalized closed with local-compute pnl'). If either leg triggers it OPENS an unintended 15-lot MES short. ROOT CAUSE: the watchdog flat-close branch (src/runtime/order_monitor.py ~5750-5880) finalises the trade and package without calling _cancel_resting_protection_after_flat; that sweep is wired only into _reconcile_orphan_exchange_positions (lines 3394, 3630). The same defect class already produced the 2026-09-16/17 cascade on ib_paper MES: adopted orphans 5830 (short 15), 5835/5836 (long 15), 5852 (short 45), 5853 (short 30), 5856 (short 15), with 5836 re-armed 54 times (protection_repair_last_kind=naked_rearm). Paper account today; ib_live is dry_run, so the defect class would reach real money on the first live IB close through the watchdog path. FIX (Tier-2 order path): (1) cancel oca-protect-t5836 now via the existing IB cancel route (operator-OK'd Tier-2 system action, or the next reconcile of MES if one runs the sweep); (2) call _cancel_resting_protection_after_flat(aid, symbol) on every flat-close path in order_monitor (watchdog, reconciler_filled in _reconcile_open_trades, close_from_order_status) scoped to the closing trade's keyed group 'oca-protect-t<id>' so a sibling's group is preserved; (3) add a test that closes a trade through _watchdog_stuck_strategies and asserts cancel_resting_protection was called. Full finding: docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A01.findings.jsonl id CA-A01-001.
